shortDescription: Six Ebola checkpoints in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo stopped reporting last month because the staff had not been paid, according to Bloomberg.The payment disputes have hampered the response to the outbreak.

children: Six Ebola checkpoints in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo stopped reporting last month because the staff had not been paid, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Congo Ebola Response Hampered by Unpaid Health Workers
